blocks.head: alt UserX is not near any device
alt UserX is near the device
alt UserX is near the device
alt UserX is near the device
alt A ticket of the device was issued more than 2 time units ago

state_rules.rule:
eq < UserX | ('near' : OldNear , ..) > $ UserX 'approach' deviceB 
= < UserX | ('near' : deviceB , ..) > .

eq < UserX | ('near' : OldNear , ..) > $ UserX 'leave' deviceB 
= < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > .

eq < system | ('counter' : N , ..) > < deviceB | (...) > $ UserX 'pressButton' deviceB 
= < system | ('counter' : N + 1 , ..) > < deviceB | (...) > $ deviceB 'uploadSecret' cloudA | (deviceB ; randomStr('Secret', N)) .

eq < system | ('time' : CurrentTime , 'counter' : N , ..) > < cloudA | (deviceB : ('tickets' : Tickets , ...) , ....) > $ deviceB 'uploadSecret' cloudA | (deviceB ; Secret) 
= < system | ('time' : CurrentTime , 'counter' : N , ..) > < cloudA | (deviceB : ('tickets' : (('secret' : Secret , 'time' : CurrentTime) , Tickets) , ...) , ....) > .

ceq < system | ('time' : CurrentTime , 'counter' : N , ..) > < cloudA | (deviceB : ('tickets' : (('secret' : Secret , 'time' : IssuedTime) , RestTickets) , ...) , ....) > $ UserX 'getKey' cloudA | (deviceB) 
= < system | ('time' : CurrentTime , 'counter' : N , ..) > < cloudA | (deviceB : ('tickets' : (('secret' : Secret , 'time' : IssuedTime) , RestTickets) , ...) , ....) > $ cloudA 'sendSecret' UserX | (deviceB ; Secret) if IssuedTime == CurrentTime .

eq < UserX | ('knowledge' : Knowledge , ..) > $ cloudA 'sendSecret' UserX | (deviceB ; Secret) 
= < UserX | ('knowledge' : (Secret , Knowledge) , ..) > .

eq < cloudA | (deviceB : ('owners' : nils , 'tickets' : (('secret' : Secret , 'time' : IssuedTime) , RestTickets) , ..) , ...) > $ UserX 'bind' cloudA | (deviceB ; Secret) 
= < cloudA | (deviceB : ('owners' : (UserX) , 'tickets' : (('secret' : Secret , 'time' : IssuedTime) , RestTickets) , ..) , ...) > .

eq < cloudA | (deviceB : ('owners' : (UserOwner , RestOwners) , 'tickets' : (('secret' : Secret , 'time' : IssuedTime) , RestTickets) , ..) , ...) > $ UserX 'join' cloudA | (deviceB ; Secret) 
= < cloudA | (deviceB : ('owners' : (UserX , UserOwner , RestOwners) , 'tickets' : (('secret' : Secret , 'time' : IssuedTime) , RestTickets) , ..) , ...) > .

ceq < system | ('time' : CurrentTime , 'counter' : N , ..) > < cloudA | (deviceB : ('tickets' : (('secret' : Secret , 'time' : IssuedTime) , RestTickets) , ...) , ....) > 
= < system | ('time' : CurrentTime , 'counter' : N , ..) > < cloudA | (deviceB : ('tickets' : nils , ...) , ....) > if CurrentTime - IssuedTime > 2 .

event_rules.label: rev1
event_rules.rule:
rl [rev1]: E @ S < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > 
=> ep: ev1(UserX) @ S < UserX | ('near' : nils , ..) > .
